verdict.rationale: There is no dedicated bulk-operations feature, but several tools imply multi-item changes. The editor's built-in agent can reorganize navigation, update docs.json and search across the entire repository. Automations run the agent on schedules or on push events. The admin MCP server gives AI tools write access to edit pages and open PRs, so agent-driven changes across many pages are plausible but not documented as bulk actions. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented bulk edit/move/delete capability across many pages, documented limits or batch semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-page bulk changes.
